description: This Java source file defines an abstract class 'AbstractCache' for entity caching within the Apache OFBiz framework. It manages cache names, prefixes, and interactions with a utility cache system, providing basic cache operations such as get, remove, and clear, parametrized by key and value types.
external_methods: UtilCache.getOrCreateUtilCache(String, int, int, int, boolean, String[])

classes.name: AbstractCache
classes.description: An abstract class providing basic cache management functionalities for entities, including cache naming conventions and interactions with a utility cache system based on a delegator and identifier.

methods.name: AbstractCache
methods.description: Constructor initializing cache with delegator name and identifier, setting cache name prefix.

methods.name: getDelegator
methods.description: Retrieves the Delegator instance associated with the given delegator name.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes cache entries for a specific entity.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears all cache entries that start with the cache name prefix.

methods.name: getCacheNamePrefix
methods.description: Returns the prefix used for cache names.

methods.name: getCacheNamePrefixes
methods.description: Returns an array of cache name prefixes used for generating cache names.

methods.name: getCacheName
methods.description: Generates the full cache name for a given entity.

methods.name: getCacheNames
methods.description: Returns an array of cache names based on prefixes and a specific entity name.

methods.name: getCache
methods.description: Retrieves the existing UtilCache for a specific entity if it exists.

methods.name: getOrCreateCache
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a UtilCache for a specific entity, ensuring cache availability.
